evidence.quote: plus a separate $9 million request for attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to court approval.
Attorneys’ fees were discussed in the parties’ proposals from the outset, alongside class relief, rather than only after the class relief was agreed.
Brightline's hard all-in cap is $40 million, so any acceptable term sheet must stay below it.
A $34 million fund plus $5 million in fees totals $39 million and leaves limited room for further movement.

summary: Plaintiff first raised a fee request in its opening proposal, and fees were negotiated alongside class relief from the outset rather than after the class fund was fixed. The transcript explicitly treats the class fund and fees as components of an all-in cap, creating fee-relief linkage. There is no clear evidence that class counsel prioritized its own fees over the class, that defense leveraged fee interest, that reverse-auction tactics occurred, or that the court declaration was misleading.
